notes.title: GAME RELEASE
notes.content:
[b]When will the game be released?[/b]

The game will be released as of now by September 6th! This is a very estimated date however and date changes are very likely. However I will be trying my best to get the game all done and dusted by this date!

[b]How do I receive notifications on this game?[/b]

If you add Passive Income to your wishlist, you will receive updates on when the game releases and any discounts that happen in the future! So be sure to add it to your wishlist so you know exactly when this game will be releasing so you can get the [u]Launch Discount[/u].

[b]How much will the launch discount be?[/b]

The launched price of the game will be 2.99$, however it will be launching at a discounted price. The Launch Discount will be 20% of for those who buy the game during its early release stages.
